dialect: Standaardnederlands zoals in Nederland (Netherlands Standard Dutch)

profile.grammar_notes: Copula zijn for identity and location/state; er is / er zijn for existence; hebben for possession and as perfect auxiliary (zijn with movement/change verbs). Verb-second in main clauses, verb-final in subordinate clauses; inversion after a fronted element. Negation: niet (verbs, adjectives, definite nouns) vs geen (indefinite nouns). Questions by inversion or question words (wie, wat, waar, wanneer, hoe, waarom). Modal set: willen, kunnen, moeten, mogen, zullen (+ infinitive at end). Separable verbs (opbellen, meenemen). Politeness marked by u vs jij/je. Closed sets: personal pronouns (ik, jij/je, u, hij, zij/ze, het, wij/we, jullie, zij/ze), articles de/het/een, modals, question words. Particles like even, maar, wel, toch, hoor soften speech. Diminutive -je very frequent. Perfect tense (hebben/zijn + voltooid deelwoord) is the default past in speech.
